courses.subject: GAST
courses.title: Cellular and Molecular Gastroenterology
courses.description: This course aims to review state-of-the-art cellular and molecular biology research that sheds new light on the pathogenesis of gastrointestinal (GI) and liver diseases and to introduce common techniques and novel technologies in laboratory research.
courses.course_syllabus:
Course Topics:

1 General introduction to cellular and molecular gastroenterology

2 Molecular landscapes of GI and liver cancers

3 Novel biomarkers and molecular targets in GI and liver diseases

4 Biological, chemical and radiation safety in laboratory research

5 Animal models of GI cancers

6 Common molecular techniques (e.g. DNA/RNA/protein isolation, real-time PCR, Western blots, immunohistochemistry, ELISA, cell culture and cloning) in GI research

7 Advanced technologies (e.g. GWAS, next-generation sequencing) in GI Research
